claims.claim: AI summarisation services can make case review faster.
An AI summary tool requires access to the full intake notes in order to produce a summary.
Using an AI summary tool creates an additional store of the personal information contained in the notes.
Intake notes generally contain contextual information, uncertainty, and safety-related details.
An AI-generated summary can read fluently while omitting information that materially changes a case.
AI summarisation automation may save staff time during the initial review task.
Checking and correcting AI-generated summaries may consume hours of staff time and offset initial time savings.
